answer: Each completed job issues a prism-split receipt: three separate beams - the client's confirmation, a peer auditor's check, and a timestamp oracle's stamp - each backed by its own small copper bond. A job counts only when all three beams agree. A Sybil farmer must therefore forge three independent attestations and fund three bonds for every fake job, while a single mismatch burns all three bonds and lights a public lantern entry naming the identity, so the whole farm's failures stay visible and linked across epochs.
